name: barnards-star
label: Barnard's Star
method: aperture photometry r=2 px, sky ring 4-7 px; Gaia neighbours within 15" fitted together
note: 345 measurements, one per SPHEREx photo; 345 flagged (345 overloaded: the star is too bright for the camera there); 332 measure only the glow around an overloaded core (shows changes, not total brightness); error bars widened x40.1 to match the real scatter.
light_curve_band: 2.4-3.8 um, glow around the overloaded core (4-7 px from the centre)

variability.text: no change beyond the uncertainty (steady within about 5%)
